lessons.title: Compile and run a program.
lessons.explain: Every program starts at main. You compile first and run the binary after, so many errors show up before execution.
lessons.exercise: Compile with g++ and change the message to print your name.

lessons.title: Store lists with std::vector.
lessons.explain: std::vector is a resizable array and the default container. Algorithms like sort work on iterator ranges.
lessons.exercise: Read five numbers into a vector and print them in descending order.

lessons.title: Addresses, references and memory.
lessons.explain: A pointer stores an address and a reference is an alias. Dereferencing with * reads or writes the original value.
lessons.exercise: Write a function that swaps two ints using references.

lessons.title: Objects, constructors and RAII.
lessons.explain: A class keeps data and behavior together. The constructor sets the object up and the destructor cleans it up automatically.
lessons.exercise: Add a perimeter method to Box and print both values.

capstone: A text-based inventory manager that saves and loads from disk.
